observations: Photo 0 and 1 show nearly identical views of a living room furniture set on black marble-pattern tile flooring.
Center piece is a 2-seater sofa with ornate gold-painted carved wood frame, maroon/red button-tufted fabric with crystal-style buttons.
Two single armchairs flank the sofa, same maroon fabric and tufting style but with plain wood frames (no gold carving), suggesting a different/simpler manufacture than the center sofa.
A standing fan and a patterned window blind are visible in the background of both shots.
A semi-transparent watermark reading 'POSTED ON' and 'LOVELY MICHAEL' overlays both images.
No close-up shots of fabric texture, stitching, stains, tears, or frame joints are provided.
No shot shows the underside, legs, or back of any piece.
Lighting is even but photos are taken from a similar angle, giving little additional information between the two.

identity.kind: 2-seater sofa with 2 matching single armchairs (ornate gold-frame sofa set)

claims.claim: Royal unique 2 seater and complementary 2 singles sofas
claims.evidence: Marketing/style description, not a verifiable fact from the photos.
No close-up of fabric condition, stains, or frame wear in either photo; both shots are wide-angle and near-identical.

risks.risk: Hidden stains, tears, or fabric fading not visible at this distance
risks.proof: Close-up photos of seat cushions, armrests, and backrest fabric
risks.if_unproven: priced as visibly used with unverified fabric condition (worst case: stained/worn)

risks.risk: Structural integrity of wood frame (cracks, wobble, loose joints) especially on the ornate gold sofa
risks.proof: Short video of someone sitting on the sofa and chairs, and a shot of the frame joints/legs
risks.if_unproven: priced as structurally unverified, i.e., assume possible wobble/damage

risks.risk: Mismatch between the ornate center sofa and the plainer armchairs suggesting they may not be an original matched set
risks.proof: Photo showing maker's tag/label or a closer comparison shot of frame details on all three pieces
risks.if_unproven: priced as a mixed/assembled set, not a designer matched suite

risks.risk: Odor, pest infestation (common issue with used upholstered furniture)
risks.proof: Not provable remotely; would need in-person inspection
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming unknown odor/pest risk, i.e., discounted

risks.risk: Actual dimensions unknown, affecting fit and value
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure against each piece, or dimensions stated against a known reference object
risks.if_unproven: priced using generic 2-seater + armchair dimensions, not confirmed

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the fabric on all three pieces (seat, back, arms) showing any stains, tears, or fading
A short video of someone sitting on the sofa and each armchair to show stability
A photo of the underside/legs and back of each piece
A tape-measure photo showing width/depth/height of the 2-seater and the armchairs
A clear photo of any maker's label or tag if present
response.reason: The set is clearly identifiable by type (an ornate gold-frame 2-seater sofa with two matching-fabric but plainer-frame armchairs) and shows visible used condition, so it can be priced at worst case pending close-up proof of fabric and frame condition.
